name: Lightsource bp
program: Agrivoltaics research with agricultural and academic partners
collect_note: Lightsource bp (a solar developer) has no grants listing; a research partnership, studentship or funding call would be announced as a post on its WordPress news feed, so the engine reads the site's wp-json posts list (latest 100, titles only) twice a day and keeps only titles that name a call, studentship, research grant or research partnership. Hidden candidates (auto_vet false) because news titles are not always a call.

zero_reason.quote: At Lightsource bp, we aim to continue to evolve our agrivoltaics projects by investing in research with agricultural and academic partners to verify our outcomes and scale solutions.
zero_reason.note: Research funding here is by partnership and invitation: no call, application route or amount is published anywhere on lightsourcebp.com (agrivoltaics page, non-profit partnerships page, wp-json posts, feed, sitemaps checked 2026-11-12), so nothing is open today. Filter tested against the title of its last known research-partnership announcement, Partnership to Explore Solar Farms and Agriculture (2014-11-19, with University of Northampton and Moulton College), which it matches.
